args.reason: The PRDR serves the first PRD goal directly: --dry-run lets operators see the current merge-ok or blocked decision with no merge. Every DoD item is about the current decision and the absence of a gh pr merge call; nothing adds historical storage or query, which the PRD excludes. Reusing the existing floor reads keeps the merge-floor logic as the single source of truth, so the second goal is respected. No capability exceeds the declared goals and no cited goal is left unserved.
